guidetextdraw._value: INSTRUCTIONS: Before further action can be taken on your financial aid application, the following information is required. Please verify information regarding the value your Parents' investments and real estate, excluding their principal residence. See definition of parent below. Attach copies of the documentation used to calculate the value and debt of items listed below. Several documents may be used to verify real estate or investment value and debt (e.g., statements from a real estate office, mortgage statement, local newspaper ads, and/or comparable property listings). Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1671624916373

guidetextdraw_21219850._value:
Definition of parent: For the FAFSA, “parent” refers to your biological and/ or adoptive parents (including your stepparent If that person is currently married to your “parent”).
The following are NOT considered to be a “legal parent” for the FAFSA:

  • Grandparents, foster parents, legal guardians, aunts and uncles are NOT considered parents unless legally adopted you.
  • Any person who is not married to your parent and who is not a legal or biological parent

If your parent’s FAFSA marital status is “married,” or “unmarried and both parents living together,” then both their  information must be provided.
guidetextdraw_21219850.name: textdraw_212198501672030808304

guidetextdraw._value:
ACTION TO COMPLETE FORM:
Enter a value in each line below for the value of your parents' investments as of the day your FAFSA was filed. Do not leave blank spaces, use zeroes when appropriate.

Investment Value - List the value and debt of your parents' investments. Investments include: college savings plans, trust funds, money market funds, mutual funds, certificates of deposit, stocks, bonds, other securities, installment and land sale contracts (including mortgages held), commodities, precious and strategic metals, etc. Do not include the value of life insurance and retirement plans (pension funds, annuities, IRAs, Keogh plans, etc.)
guidetextdraw.name: textdraw1671625185492

guidetextdraw_1652728516._value: Real Estate Investment Value - List the value and debt of your parents' real estate investments, please exclude their principal residence. Other real estate includes rental property, land, second or summer homes, the rental portion of family home that maintains a separate entrance, etc. In determining real estate value, indicate the expected market value if the properties were sold today. List each property separately.
guidetextdraw_1652728516.name: textdraw_16527285161671625409234
